message: The other night, we had a little power outage, and it turned into quite the family group chat moment! I shared this cozy setup with my hand-crank radio and some water, and my kids chimed in with their own blackout stories. It’s funny how these small hiccups can spark such great conversations. What’s your favorite family memory from a power outage?
scene: a shelf with a hand-crank radio, candles unlit, and a jug of water (on a rainy afternoon)
